name: EssBar
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to EssBar in Mieders** – your culinary escape in the heart of the **Tirol** Alps!

Indulge in our **Kaiserschmarrn**, fluffy and caramelized, served with fresh fruit compote or a dollop of vanilla cream. Savor the rich flavors of our **Tiroler Gröstl**, a hearty mix of potatoes, onions, and crispy bacon, topped with a fried egg and melted cheese.

For meat lovers, our **Schweinsbraten** (roast pork) with **Kraut** and dumplings is a must-try. Pair it with a crisp **Tiroler Bier** or a glass of our house **Apfelwein** for the perfect match.

Fresh from the oven, our **Käsekrainer** (cheese-filled sausages) with **Senf** and mustard bread are a local favorite. And don’t miss our **Apfelstrudel**—warm, spiced, and dusted with powdered sugar.

At **EssBar**, we blend traditional **Tirol** recipes with modern twists, all made with the finest local ingredients. Whether you’re craving comfort food or a light snack, our menu has something for every palate.

**Come visit us in Mieders**—where every bite tells a story of **Tirol**’s rich culinary heritage!
